mapper.select: SELECT attendance_id, member_id, work_date, start_time, end_time, status, created_at FROM attendance WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND work_date = DATE(DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 9 HOUR))
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO attendance ( member_id, work_date, start_time, end_time, status ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, DATE(DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 9 HOUR)), DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 9 HOUR), NULL, '근무중' )
mapper.update: UPDATE attendance SET end_time = DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 9 HOUR), status = '퇴근' WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND work_date = DATE(DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 9 HOUR)) AND end_time IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT attendance_id, member_id, work_date, start_time, end_time, status, created_at FROM attendance WHERE member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY work_date DESC LIMIT 30

SELECT COALESCE( SUM( CASE WHEN vacation_member.member_id IS NULL AND today_attendance.start_time IS NOT NULL AND today_attendance.end_time IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), 0 ) AS working_count,
COALESCE( SUM( CASE WHEN vacation_member.member_id IS NULL AND today_attendance.end_time IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), 0 ) AS finished_count,
COALESCE( SUM( CASE WHEN vacation_member.member_id IS NULL AND today_attendance.member_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), 0 ) AS absent_count,
COALESCE( SUM( CASE WHEN vacation_member.member_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), 0 ) AS vacation_count
FROM member m
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT member_id, MAX(start_time) AS start_time, MAX(end_time) AS end_time FROM attendance WHERE work_date = DATE(DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 9 HOUR)) GROUP BY member_id ) today_attendance ON today_attendance.member_id = m.id
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT member_id FROM vacation WHERE status = '승인' AND DATE(DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 9 HOUR)) BETWEEN start_date AND end_date ) vacation_member ON vacation_member.member_id = m.id
